title: Galaxies at redshifts 5 to 6 with systematically low dust content and high [C II] emission
question: Do typical z~5-6 star-forming galaxies show lower dust content and enhanced [CII] relative to FIR compared with z<3 systems?

what.value: COSMOS photometric redshift catalog optical/NIR photometry

evidence.quote: Optical and near infrared data were obtained from the COSMOS photometric redshift catalog
Sizes were taken from the COSMOS Hubble Space Telescope Advanced Camera for Surveys (HST-ACS) weak lensing catalog

what.value: Grey body FIR SED parameter ranges from z~2-5 objects

evidence.quote: total infrared (3-1100μm) luminosity was derived using the range of grey body models covering the full range of objects observed at z~2-5

recipe.method: Additional flagging, re-imaging with Briggs weighting to make continuum, moment zero and channel maps

recipe.goal: Fit [CII] lines and continuum, derive redshift, FWHM, flux, sizes
recipe.method: Gaussian fitting of spectra and image components; centroid compared to [CII] rest frequency

recipe.goal: Derive infrared luminosity from the single 158um point
recipe.method: Scale grey body models to observed rest-frame 158 um flux
assumptions: FIR SEDs follow z~2-5 grey body range

recipe.goal: Measure UV slope beta and UV luminosity
recipe.method: Power-law fit to rest-frame 0.13-0.3 um photometry; alternate fit 0.15-0.3 um to estimate systematic

recipe.goal: Compare to IRX-beta relations and test robustness; stack non-detections
recipe.method: Compare IRX vs beta with Meurer and SMC relations; predicted vs measured mean flux of undetected sources
assumptions: Meurer relation typical of z<3; SMC-like dust model

recipe.method: Mdyn = 1.16e5 Vcir^2 D with Vcir = 1.763 sigma/sin(i), i from axis ratio

evidence.quote: This range of parameters resulted in a systematic uncertainty of 0.3 dex in the derived luminosity.

answer_key.quantity: Effect on z~6 star formation density

evidence.quote: result in ~30-40% less StarFormation at z~6 than previously thought

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum imaging bandwidth used

score_reason: Public data and numeric tables, but imaging and fit details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data with numeric tables of fluxes, though processing details are incomplete.
